newsitem.title: UK: Abbey National shuns FTSE 100 advance.
newsitem.headline: Abbey National shuns FTSE 100 advance.

text.p: Shares in banking group Abbey National Plc dropped on Wednesday, extending recent declines as surplus stock continued to wash around the market, dealers said.
Abbey shares were down 4p at 832-1/2 by 09052 GMT in volume of 872,945 shares, even as the FTSE 100 index gained 79.7 points to 4,926.4.

Dealers said a number of factors could have weighed on Abbey shares, ranging from J Sainsbury Plc's plan to offer mortgages to cautious comments from mortgage lender Northern Rock on the state of the housing market.
However they were hard pressed to identify any single factor that had depressed the stock.
"There has been a bit of stock around...it looks like a stale bull position," said one.
Abbey reports first-half results on July 29. Its shares hit a record 973p on May 16.
